markdown-lsp-mcp — Local MCP server exposing markdown-lsp tools over stdio.

Usage:
  npx markdown-lsp-mcp --docs <path>

Options:
  --docs <path>   Path to docs directory (default: ./docs)
  --help, -h      Show this help

Tools exposed:
  doc_outline, doc_workspace_outline, doc_search_text, doc_search_symbols,
  doc_search_links_to, doc_search_links_from, doc_resolve_link,
  doc_get_section, doc_search_paths
